Two robots stop announcing while a third runs on, and neither sends a departure notice.
Fragmented camera frames that never reassemble.
The same camera frames on two topics, differing only in reliability.
Eight connection attempts, seven refused, and no Zenoh at all.
The Zenoh router dies mid-session, sessions close, then reconnection succeeds.
